name: Banner of the Fallen

angles.text: Mountaineer Ylva died defending Ironforge’s honor while searching for missing kin. Recovering her trampled banner and avenging her death strikes at the heart of dwarven pride and duty.
The Ironforge standard represents dwarven allegiance and defiance in trogg territory. Securing it honors the fallen soldiers who hold the line for the Alliance.

faq.answer: Mountaineer Ylva was an independent-minded dwarf who entered trogg country to search for mountaineers who never returned from patrol. She carried an Ironforge standard and sought to show dwarven resolve against the troggs before they struck her down.

aliases: what is banner of the fallen
what happens in banner of the fallen
faq.answer: You find Mountaineer Ylva’s body and the trampled Ironforge standard she carried. Raising the banner draws out her killer, the trogg Headsplitter, so you can avenge her and return the standard to Captain Rugelfuss.
faq.q: What is the quest Banner of the Fallen about?

faq.answer: A trogg known as Headsplitter killed Ylva. It may have used a heavy spiked club to deliver the fatal blow to her skull and knock off her helm. Raising the Ironforge standard provokes the creature to return.

aliases: where do i turn in the banner
faq.answer: Captain Rugelfuss is the dwarven officer overseeing mountaineer operations, and he receives Ylva’s recovered banner. He recognizes her bravery and fierce independence, and promises to clean and display the standard in her honor.

aliases: why did ylva go into trogg territory
faq.answer: Ylva went alone to investigate the disappearance of mountaineers who had not returned from a patrol through trogg country. Fiercely independent, she carried the banner to show that Ironforge would never bow to troggs.
faq.q: Why did Mountaineer Ylva go into trogg territory alone?

faq.answer: Headsplitter remembers the Ironforge standard from striking down Mountaineer Ylva. Planting and raising the trampled banner again provokes the trogg to return and finish what it started.
faq.q: How is the trogg Headsplitter lured out?

sections.body: Mountaineer Ylva’s trampled Ironforge standard marks where the Alliance scout met her end. She entered trogg territory to find comrades who had vanished on patrol, carrying the city’s banner as a sign of defiance. A powerful trogg struck with enough force to shatter her defenses. The standard was left in the dirt.
sections.title: The Trampled Standard

sections.body: Headsplitter, the brute responsible for Ylva’s death, recognized the Ironforge standard and the threat it posed. Raising the fallen banner openly challenges the trogg and draws it back to defend its kill. Once Headsplitter is slain, the battered standard can be returned to Captain Rugelfuss. He arranges for Ylva’s weapon to be passed on and the banner to be cleaned and preserved in her honor.
sections.title: Vengeance for Ylva

summary: In trogg territory, Mountaineer Ylva’s search for missing comrades ended beneath the trampled standard of Ironforge. Raising it again draws out the trogg that struck her down.
